messages:
Maya (AE): Customer asked for CAIQ-level BCP/DR details: RTO/RPO by deployment, backup cadence, failover type (hot/warm/cold), and a sanitized drill log.
Arjun (SE): Will draft. Do they want SLA numbers or operational SLOs too? SIG often expects both.
Maya (AE): Both. Also asked whether active streaming sessions are recoverable.
Noah (Security): Note for CAIQ: call out limitations—no formal RPO for in-flight WebSocket streams. Include control refs for DR planning, backups, and key management.
Tess (SRE): Ops summary:
- Hosted API: SLA 99.9% regional. SLO target 99.93% (90d). RTO target 60m to restore API via multi-region failover. RPO 5m for persisted KV; streaming sessions best-effort with 2m checkpoints. Backups: incremental snapshots every 5m, daily full exports. Retention: snapshots 30d.
- Dedicated: Typical contract SLA 99.95%. RTO target ~30m for pool failover. RPO configurable (default 1-15m). Backups to customer-controlled storage; supports CMKs.
- Private/on-prem: customer infra dependent; we supply runbook and tooling for warm standby.
Arjun (SE): Add definitions:
- Hot: active synchronized replicas, near-zero RTO.
- Warm: recent snapshots, RTO minutes to an hour.
- Cold: offline backups, RTO hours+.
Maya (AE): They want sanitized drill evidence.
Tess (SRE): Example (sanitized):
Drill: regional failover exercise - 2026-01-18
Detection: 00:12
Failover start: 00:14
Traffic on secondary: 00:35
KV rehydrate complete: 00:44
Service healthy: 00:50
Observed RTO: 38m
Observed RPO: 4m (some streaming tails lost; tokens reissued)
Follow-up: detection tuning and cache optimizations.
Noah (Security): For CAIQ include AES-256 at rest, TLS1.2+ in transit, KMS support (customer-managed keys) for Dedicated/Private. Note quarterly DR exercises and IAM controls for runbook edits.
Arjun (SE): I'll assemble CAIQ responses and attach the redacted drill summary. ETA EOD PT.
DeployBot: status page: https://status.redwood.ai (90d uptime 99.89%).
Maya (AE): Great, thanks everyone. I'll send to the buyer once draft is ready.
